subject: CDBG Annual Action Plan
overview: City staff held a public hearing to outline the annual Community Development Block Grant process and receive feedback from residents and local service agencies. Attendees discussed CDBG-funded public services, capital projects, and supplemental ARPA grant opportunities.

items.title: CDBG Program Presentation
items.summary: City staff presented an overview of the CDBG program, detailing low- and moderate-income guidelines, funding allocation caps, and upcoming municipal improvement projects.

items.title: Public Comment from Service Providers and Residents
items.summary: Community members and agency representatives shared feedback on CDBG-funded services, highlighting the impact of senior transportation, ESOL classes, food security, and housing support.

items.title: ARPA Grant Coordination
items.summary: Staff discussed coordinating CDBG applications with available American Rescue Plan Act funds to help address funding requests that exceed CDBG allocations.
